name: pocket-train-optimizer
description: Pocket Trains route-efficiency model and progress checklist

scripts.test: node --check assets/app.js && node --check assets/monte-carlo.js && node --check assets/monte-carlo-worker.js && node --check assets/world-map.js && node --check assets/operating-core.js && node --check assets/operating-worker.js && node --check assets/operating.js && node --check assets/corridor-map-core.js && node --check assets/corridor-lab.js && node --check assets/corridor-comparison.js && node --test tests/*.test.cjs
scripts.corridors:search: python3 scripts/corridor_search.py && python3 scripts/add-corridor-loop-examples.py && python3 scripts/build-corridor-candidates.py && node scripts/evaluate-corridors.cjs && python3 scripts/migrate-corridor-reference.py && node scripts/build-corridor-maps.cjs && python3 scripts/render-corridor-maps.py && python3 scripts/document-corridor-search.py
scripts.corridors:connected: set -e; candidates=$(mktemp); trap 'rm -f "$candidates"' EXIT; python3 scripts/search-connected-corridors.py > "$candidates"; node scripts/evaluate-connected-corridors.cjs < "$candidates"; python3 scripts/package-connected-corridors.py
scripts.corridors:long-haul: set -e; candidates=$(mktemp); trap 'rm -f "$candidates"' EXIT; python3 scripts/search-long-haul-corridors.py > "$candidates"; node scripts/evaluate-long-haul-corridors.cjs < "$candidates"; python3 scripts/build-corridor-targets.py
scripts.corridors:average: set -e; candidates=$(mktemp); trap 'rm -f "$candidates"' EXIT; python3 scripts/search-average-corridors.py --pool "$candidates"; node scripts/screen-average-corridors.cjs "$candidates"; python3 scripts/build-corridor-targets.py; node scripts/compare-corridor-plans.cjs
scripts.corridors:final: set -e; candidates=$(mktemp); trap 'rm -f "$candidates"' EXIT; python3 scripts/search-final-corridors.py "$candidates"; node scripts/evaluate-final-corridors.cjs "$candidates"; python3 scripts/build-corridor-targets.py; node scripts/compare-corridor-plans.cjs
